## STARTING A NEW THREAD (new topic)

Open a new chat in The Clarity Factory Claude project and type:

  "I'm continuing work on The Clarity Factory. I want to build a new buyer's
  guide for [topic]. Run Stage 0 autonomously and tell me what you find before
  asking me anything."

No file uploads needed — all framework files are in the project knowledge base.

---

## THREAD NAMING CONVENTION

  Clarity Factory | [Topic] | V1

Examples:
  Clarity Factory | Outdoor Cooking | V1
  Clarity Factory | Wigs | V1

Increment V# at each handoff within the same topic.
